title: review: H4 fix round 9: usd for reservations is derived from tokens when a run row has no cost field (Codex rows), so the estimate median and the goal dollar cap stay meaningful; reconcile_dead releases with the whole result so top-level cost is kept (review T-0421)
spec:
STEP 0: the worktree must contain the rebased H4 chain through f27c9a4 (T-0419) in git log; never drop or amend it.
Review T-0421 on T-0419, findings to address:
1. (high) orchestrator/pool.py:355 release() and _reservation_estimate() read cost from usage["usd"] or usage["total_cost_usd"], but executor._run's Codex path returns raw token counts with no cost field, so once five or more execute runs exist the median usd settles at 0.0, every execute reservation gets est_usd 0, and a configured goal_budget_usd["execute"] cap is a permanent no-op. Fix: one helper usd_of(row_or_usage, executor_or_account) that returns the recorded usd when present, else tokens converted with the executor's or account's configured usd-per-token ratio, else [limits].default_tokens_per_usd (already documented as an estimate); mark such values estimated (est_usd_source: "tokens") in the ledger; the history median uses the same helper so Codex rows contribute non-zero estimates. Test: tests/test_pool.py::test_estimate_uses_token_derived_usd_for_codex_rows (five Codex rows without usd yield a positive est_usd and a working goal cap).
2. (med) orchestrator/daemon.py:348 reconcile_dead passes only result["usage"] to pool.release, dropping the top-level usd that Claude results carry; pass the whole result (usage plus usd fields) and let release() use usd_of. Test: tests/test_daemon.py::test_reconcile_dead_release_keeps_top_level_cost.
3. (low) no code change: the acceptance wording about grepping daemon.py for notified was imprecise; behaviour is covered by test_notify_once_per_transition.
Keep every H4 lineage test green. Run .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh from the worktree root twice (exit 0 both), then git add -A and git commit with the task id; report sha and failures only.
acceptance: git log --oneline in the worktree shows f27c9a4 and the rebased H4 chain below your commit

one helper derives usd from tokens when a row lacks a cost field and both release() and the estimate use it (grep shows a single usd_of definition and no direct usage['usd'] reads elsewhere in pool.py)

tests/test_pool.py reservation tests, tests/test_daemon.py::test_notify_once_per_transition, ::test_budget_refusal_leaves_task_queued_without_repair, ::test_dispatch_passes_no_placeholder_ids and tests/test_executor.py::test_fallback_handoff_keeps_reservation_until_worker_finishes, ::test_worker_refusal_requeues_without_hold still pass
